description: Fetches reviews for a HireNimbus provider by slug. Does not require authentication. Inputs include slug, page, page size, and optional context. Returns review text, ratings, dates, and review sources where available. Read-only.

context.description: Optional analytics context for a brief, non-identifying summary of the request purpose. The value is recorded as Agent Intent.
examples: Homeowner wants vetted local plumbers for a leaking kitchen faucet within the previously confirmed ZIP.
Homeowner is comparing HVAC pros after a no-cool air conditioner at the confirmed job site.
context.title: Context

name: get_provider_reviews
title: Get provider reviews
